state.claim: Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (HMWSSB) is delivering 1kg bleaching powder, chlorine tablets to people’s doorsteps

candidates.quote: If your household water storage sump is mixed with rain water, pl empty it and clean & disinfect with bleaching powder and refill sump with HMWSSB water. As precaution pl mix the water with chlorine tablets. Chlorine tablets are distributed by HMWSSB staff at your doorstep.

# K Ashok Reddy, IAS on X: "If your household water storage sump is mixed with rain water, pl empty it and clean & disinfect with bleaching powder and refill sump with HMWSSB water. As precaution pl mix the water with chlorine tablets. Chlorine tablets are distributed by HMWSSB staff at your doorstep."
